title: Paul McCartney live: Mount Smart Stadium, Auckland | 2017
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Mount Smart Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand, on 16 December 2017.

Lovin NZ. Been a long time! x ?? pic.twitter.com/3K8j82ISeU

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) December 14, 2017

It was the final show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017. This concert was seen by 34,901 fans.

We’ve been waiting to get back to Australia and New Zealand for years and now it’s finally happening. It is very exciting. I’m really looking forward to the concerts as we’ve always had such a brilliant time whenever we’ve been before so we know we are in for a treat. Can’t wait to see you and all rock out together.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Paul McCartney (@paulmccartney)

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums). They were joined by the Auckland & District Pipe Band for ‘Mull Of Kintyre’.
